title: Invoices made before the release read the payer's current IBS account
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the production test account, connected to IBS.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, created on production before the release, with an IBS account number.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced through IBS on production before the release.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
  2. Change customer A's IBS account number to a new one.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Open work order 1.
  5. Open the Finance tab.
  6. Open the invoice's document.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • The IBS field shows the new number.

Step 3:

  • The window closes.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 5:

  • The Finance tab lists the invoice.

Step 6:

  • The invoice shows "(IBS#: [customer A's new IBS number])": invoices created before the release read the current account.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12321 (Story 19, IBS, invoice export and Public API)
